text_block_list.text: One day, while waiting in a long line at a ramen shop with Fine Motion as usual—
While we were waiting, a thought crossed my mind, so I asked about something that had been bugging me for a while.
choice_data_list: Why did you come to love ramen so much?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Oh. Trainer.
So that's what you want to ask about?
choice_data_list: I was just wondering what sparked it all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. That was back when
I was studying Japanese culture in preparation for studying abroad—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Bounties of the sea, bounties of the mountains... I see.
Japan's culinary culture is so remarkably rich that it makes one thoroughly appreciate the phrase.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...? Ramen...?
There's an entire special feature dedicated just to this.

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, "RAMEN"—Japanese noodles that are
gaining quite a bit of attention in Ireland, too.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My... Japanese cuisine, which is captivating
even our citizens—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: If it is a food that connects both nations, then as an international student, I must certainly learn about it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: J-Just from the number of blog posts alone, there's this many...!?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The passion the people of Japan hold for ramen...
It seems it's anything but ordinary...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "There are so many... with '-kei' attached to them...!?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
This "such-and-such lineage" thing
is surely like a school of thought—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Just like the floral and martial arts—
it is something passed down and cultivated...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: My goodness! To think there is a fierce debate merely over whether to start with the noodles or the broth...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"It truly is a profound culinary culture, isn't it...?
I can't go sparking a controversy when eating it—"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Now that it's come to this...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Dia duit. Thank you for taking the time to come.
Ambassador, as someone well-versed in Japanese culture, I would be honored to learn from you...

text_block_list.name: Japanese Ambassador
text_block_list.text:
I hear that someone as wise as you is struggling.
...Indeed, Japan has many cultural practices with their own unique etiquette.

text_block_list.name: Japanese Ambassador
text_block_list.text:
Please, ask anything. If necessary,
I can introduce you to someone even more knowledgeable.
All so you may study abroad without any worries...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, how reassuring...!
Well then, I shall leave it in your capable hands.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Please instruct me
in the proper etiquette for eating ramen.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
S-So then... the disputes surrounding ramen aren't
about manners, but rather personal opinions...?

text_block_list.name: Japanese Ambassador
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha.
Dear me, what an adorable misunderstanding...

text_block_list.name: Japanese Ambassador
text_block_list.text:
My lady. In Japan, ramen is loved
by everyone, young and old alike.

text_block_list.name: Japanese Ambassador
text_block_list.text:
"As a result, both the varieties and ways of eating them have multiplied.
Reflecting regional traits and personal tastes...
each has evolved into a form beloved by all."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Beloved by the people, wished for... reflecting their hopes everywhere...!

text_block_list.name: Japanese Ambassador
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes.
Ramen is vast, and free.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Ramen is vast, and free...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: (To think that a food that envelops and carries an entire country like this actually exists...)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(...I want to know.
I want to truly, genuinely know who you are...!)

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
"...Ever since that day, Lady Fine seems
to have become even more infatuated with ramen..."

text_block_list.name: Fine's Father
text_block_list.text:
...She isn't the type of girl to get out of hand.
Let her do as she pleases.

...At any rate,
I was able to hear the story of how she
encountered the ramen of her dreams.
